role: The interface blocks implement when they own a tile entity: create the tile entity, and get a callback when it is broken.

members.name: createNewTileEntity
members.note: the kind switch at te_new builds each provider's tile entity (TE_CHEST, TE_FURNACE, TE_SKULL, ...)

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: the per-block break hook runs the provider's breakBlock body (container drops, skull drop, sign/hopper teardown)

notes: Implemented by BlockContainer and its subclasses plus BlockSkull, BlockFlowerPot, BlockBed and the other single-tile-entity blocks; each carries its own record. The te-* snapshot recordings and test_tileticks.c exercise the tile entity lifecycle.
